question: Name the mirror which is used in the side mirrors of cars.
solution:
The correct answer is Convex.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vehicle side mirrors are convex mirrors.**
 
• A convex mirror has a **greater field of view** than a plane mirror because it can cover more area due to the smaller size of the image.
 
• They are employed wherever a mirror with** a wide field of view** is required because of this.
 
• For instance, a car's passenger-side rearview mirror is convex.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plane mirror**

 
 
• Having a **flat (planar) reflective surface** makes a mirror a **plane mirror**. The **angle of incidence** and **angle of reflection** is the same for light beams striking a **planar mirror.**
 
 
 
• **Parabolic mirror**
 
 
• A reflective surface used to gather or project energy, such as light, sound, or radio waves, is known as a **parabolic reflector.** The surface created by a parabola rotating around its axis is what gives it its shape, which is a** circular paraboloid.**
 
 
 
• **Concave mirror**
 
 
• A concave mirror has **an inward-curving reflective surface** that faces away from the light source. Light is reflected inward by concave mirrors to **a single focus point.**
